stem.text: The photomicrograph shows cells undergoing mitosis.

stem.alt: Photomicrograph of cells in mitosis, with a label X and a leader line pointing to one cell.

stem.text: Which statement describes what will happen next in cell **X**?

A.text: Chromatin coils up tightly, and the nuclear envelope breaks down.

B.text: Chromosomes line up along the equator of the cell and attach to the spindle.

C.text: Sister chromatids move towards opposite poles, pulled by the spindle fibres.

D.text: Spindle fibres break down, and the cell prepares for cytokinesis.
